description: Comprehensive question bank on Government Schemes and Programmes for KEA FDA/SDA examination, based on 'KEA FDA / SDA GOVERNMENT SCHEMES AND PROGRAMMES — CURRENT 2026' (research cutoff 30 October 2026). Verify and expand questions before formal examination use.

questions.subject: Government Schemes
questions.chapter: Understanding the types of government schemes
questions.question: A Central Sector Scheme (CS) is financed how?

options.A: Fully by the Union Government from the Central Government budget
options.B: Jointly by the Union and State governments
options.C: Fully by the State Government budget

questions.explanation: A Central Sector Scheme is financed fully by the Union Government from the Central Government budget and is generally implemented by a Central Ministry, Department or its agencies.

questions.subject: Government Schemes
questions.chapter: Understanding the types of government schemes
questions.question: A Centrally Sponsored Scheme (CSS) is financed how?

options.C: Jointly by the Union and State/UT governments

questions.explanation: A Centrally Sponsored Scheme is financed jointly by the Union and State/UT governments and implemented through State/UT machinery, with the Centre determining broad objectives and guidelines.

questions.subject: Government Schemes
questions.chapter: Understanding the types of government schemes
questions.question: In a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, who determines the broad objectives and guidelines?
questions.explanation: In a CSS, the Centre determines broad objectives and guidelines, while States undertake implementation and may adapt delivery to local conditions.

questions.subject: Government Schemes
questions.chapter: Understanding the types of government schemes
questions.question: How should a scheme be classified in an MCQ?

options.C: By the number of beneficiaries only
options.D: By the year of launch only

questions.subject: Government Schemes
